title: Edict of Milan: tolerance for Christians
summary: Emperors Constantine and Licinius agreed to treat Christians kindly and allow religious freedom; the surviving text is a letter, not a formal edict.
why: Gave Christians legal status and relief from persecution, opening the way for Christianity's rise.

notes.problem: 'Ended persecution' overstates source's 'reprieve from persecution'; scholars doubt a formal edict existed.
